subject: AWS Marketplace metering: canary entitlements & fulfillment activation
messages:
From: Alison Wu <alison.wu@amazon.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DataWave: metering & fulfillment kickoff

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. DataWave is ready to move the SaaS listing to fulfillment, and we need to align on a few things so the metering + entitlement handoff is clean. Specifically: 

- Entitlement mapping: DataWave will surface plan IDs on their side; we'll need a mapping to the AWS entitlement SKUs and the Redwood product SKUs.
- Canary activation: they'd like a 48-hour canary with reduced allocations before full go-live. Need approved times so we can coordinate marketplace routing.
- Billing point-of-contact and DocuSign for the SaaS contract amendment (they've already started procurement).

Attaching the marketplace checklist from Partner SA (attachment: aws_saas_checklist.pdf). Can you share your entitlement template and a proposed activation window?

Appreciate it — Alison

--
Alison Wu
Senior Partner Sales, AWS Marketplace
amazon.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alison Wu <alison.wu@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DataWave: metering & fulfillment kickoff

Alison — thanks, and great meeting this morning. I uploaded a first-pass entitlement template (redwood_entitlement_map_v1.xlsx) and am attaching it here for DataWave to fill in. Key notes:

- Template columns: DataWavePlanID | DataWavePlanName | RedwoodSKU | AWSEntitlementSKU | BillingMetric (monthly_active_users / seats / concurrent) | UsageUnit.
- For the canary we typically do a 48-hour window at 5-10% capacity with a fallback to manual fulfillment if the entitlement webhook misfires. Suggested window: Mar 29 17:00 UTC - Mar 31 17:00 UTC (we can adjust).
- Fulfillment webhook: Ben will own the webhook contract and runtime; Karthik will validate signing and retry semantics.

Ben / Karthik — can you confirm the webhook SLA and whether we need any additional headers for signature verification?

Jasmine Liu
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0134
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_entitlement_map_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-23T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DataWave: metering & fulfillment kickoff

Quick technical notes after reviewing the template: 

- Webhook contract: POST /fulfillment/event with JSON payload {"customer_id","plan_id","entitlement_sku","effective_at","quantity"}. We sign with HMAC-SHA256 using the shared secret.
- Retry policy: exponential backoff x5, then move to manual reconciliation flag. We'll return 200 OK to ack; 429/5xx will trigger retries.
- Idempotency: use event_id header to dedupe.

Action items for DataWave: send us a mapping of their internal PlanIDs -> desired billing metric (e.g., MAU vs seats). If they're using per-seat billing we need seat rosters at activation or a seat-reporting webhook.

Also flagging Marcus Lin from Finance for any questions on invoicing flows (cc'd).

Ben Carter
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: fulfillment_contract_sample.json (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alison Wu <alison.wu@amazon.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-24T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DataWave: metering & fulfillment kickoff

Alison — looping you in on a couple of implementation constraints so the marketplace side is aware.

On Tue, Mar 22, 2027 at 10:03 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alison — thanks, and great meeting this morning. I uploaded a first-pass entitlement template...

Notes: 
- AWS marketplace sometimes enforces SKU length constraints and requires alpha-numeric only values for entitlement keys. If DataWave's PlanIDs contain special chars we'll need a canonicalized SKU mapping.
- For canary traffic routing, is the marketplace able to route only X% of traffic to the new entitlement, or do we need to implement a token-level rate limit on our side? If AWS controls the routing we can keep our side immutable and simply watch for events.

Ben — we support HMAC-SHA256 header X-RW-SIGNATURE. We'll also include a timestamp header for replay protection. Marcus, can you confirm billing tolerance for a 48-hour canary (i.e., pro-rata behavior)?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Lead Marketplace Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Rao <procurement@datawave.example>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Alison Wu <alison.wu@amazon.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@datawave.example>
Date: 2027-03-27T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DataWave: metering & fulfillment kickoff

Hi Jasmine, Alison — procurement here. We've started the DocuSign for the SaaS amendment (link below). Two asks before we can sign: 

1) Can Redwood confirm the invoicing contact and whether invoices will be issued monthly via AWS marketplace billing or directly from Redwood?
2) We need the entitlement mapping completed (attached template) by EOD Mar 28 so internal engineering can validate IDs.

DocuSign: https://app.hellosign.com/s/abc123

Sanjay — can you confirm your engineering lead will finish mapping by EOD?

Best,
Priya Rao
Strategic Sourcing, DataWave, Inc.

From: Alison Wu <alison.wu@amazon.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <procurement@datawave.example>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@datawave.example>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DataWave: metering & fulfillment kickoff

All — quick status update and confirmation: 

- Received completed entitlement map from DataWave earlier today and validated SKU canonicalization with Karthik.
- DocuSign completed; contract amendment executed (see attached activation_ticket_12345.pdf).
- AWS will open the canary routing at 2027-03-29T17:00:00-07:00 for 48 hours at 7% traffic. Please ensure your webhook endpoint is ready to accept events and that the HMAC secret has been exchanged.

If any party sees unexpected 5xx rates or event mismatches, we will pause routing and escalate. Marcus — please confirm invoicing owner and whether Redwood will bill via Marketplace or direct invoice.

Thanks everyone — excited to get this live.

Alison Wu
Senior Partner Sales, AWS Marketplace

Attachment: activation_ticket_12345.pdf (stub)
